subject: Cluster of self-serve credit grants — potential abuse (CivicAI)
content:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ALERT: bulk promo-grants issued to CivicAI test domains

Evelyn —

Quick heads up: automated monitoring flagged a cluster of self-serve promo credits (5000 free units total) that were auto-granted in the last 3 hours to ~18 accounts with closely related email patterns (onboarding+number@civicai.com) and shared device fingerprints. Attach: signup_batch_20250629.csv (list of accounts).

Top-line observations:
- Many signups originated from XX.XX.XX.XX (same subnet).
- Email patterns: onboarding1..onboarding18@civicai.com; likely scripted.
- Several accounts have identical client version and UA strings.

I recommend we pause further auto-grants to the CivicAI domain, preserve logs, and optionally reverse the credits pending manual review. I'm copying Dev for forensic details and Laura for legal hold guidance.

Thanks,
Priyom
Security & Fraud Ops
Redwood Inference

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 10:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: ALERT: bulk promo-grants issued to CivicAI test domains

Thanks Priyom — this looks actionable. Two asks:
1) Dev — can you confirm whether these accounts have non-zero token consumption post-grant (i.e., did any of them actually start generating calls)? If not, less customer impact to revert.
2) Laura — any guidance on preemptively blocking credits vs. needing customer outreach first?

I will draft a short hold note to send to CivicAI (Samir) if we decide to pause.

Evelyn
Head of Growth Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 10:25:40 -0700
Subject: Re: ALERT: bulk promo-grants issued to CivicAI test domains

Quick triage: I pulled the telemetry and attached a short PDF with device fingerprints and matching headers (device_fingerprints_report.pdf). Findings:
- 16/18 accounts show identical fingerprint hash and near-identical session start times within a 7-minute window.
- Token usage: 14 accounts show 0 token usage; 2 accounts show light exploratory calls (<= 30 tokens each).
- IPs: majority from a single cloud provider subnet (likely scripted).

Recommendation: block further auto-grants to *.civicai.com, place these accounts into a temporary "credit_hold" state (no new credits until manual review), and refund or reverse grants only for accounts with 0 usage. For accounts with small usage, consider pro-rate or partial reversal after legal review.

I can push the hold now if Evelyn approves.

- Dev

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@civicai.com>
Cc: onboarding@civicai.com
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 11:01:17 -0700
Subject: Redwood: temporary pause on promo credits to CivicAI accounts (quick verification)

Samir —

I'm Evelyn on the Redwood growth ops team. Our automated systems detected a cluster of self-serve promo credit grants tied to email addresses at civicai.com that look like scripted signups. To protect both parties while we investigate, we've placed the affected accounts into a temporary credit hold (no further credits will be granted) and prevented additional auto-grants to your domain.

Can you confirm whether the onboarding addresses (onboarding1..onboarding18@civicai.com) are legitimate test accounts you control? If so, please reply with a short confirmation and a preferred contact and we'll whitelist and restore credits immediately. If these were not created by your team please let us know and we will continue with our investigation.

We preserved logs and attached a screenshot of the admin hold state for your reference (credit_hold_screenshot.png).

Thanks for the quick turnaround — if you prefer a call, I can be available this afternoon.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Growth Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 13:40:05 -0700
Subject: Re: ALERT: bulk promo-grants issued to CivicAI test domains

Evelyn — good catch. A few legal points:
- Preserve all evidence related to these accounts (logs, payloads, enrollment timestamps). Do not discard anything until we finish the review.
- For accounts with 0 usage we can reverse the credits administratively; document the rationale in the ticket.
- For any account that has generated usage, we should avoid unilateral deletions or full account terminations without at least an outreach and 24hr window unless clear fraud is proven.

Please coordinate with Security (Priyom) to collect raw logs. Priyom — please upload a copy of the preserved artifacts to the runbook link and tag me.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 15:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: ALERT: bulk promo-grants issued to CivicAI test domains (actioned)

Update:
- I've preserved the logs and uploaded the CSV and fingerprint report to the secure runbook (https://redwood.ai/ops/runbooks/credit-abuse).
- I blocked further auto-grants to any @civicai.com addresses and applied the temporary "credit_hold" flag to the 18 accounts.
- Planned next steps: wait 24 hours for CivicAI reply. If we receive no legitimate claim, we will reverse credits for the 14 accounts with 0 usage and open a billing adjustment ticket for the 2 low-usage accounts for manual review.

Action items:
- Evelyn: confirm rollback policy (pro-rate vs full reversal) and approve proceeding after 24h.
- Laura: if we need to notify customers under terms, advise the wording and timeline.
- Dev: please keep the forensic PDF and CSV attached to the ticket.

Priyom
Security & Fraud Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: signup_batch_20250629.csv, device_fingerprints_report.pdf, credit_hold_screenshot.png
